scientific_integrity: Uses the classical alternating path/cycle adjacency criterion as prior art. Universal theorem proved by explicit counting and inequalities; finite checks are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: Valid for positive rectangular dimensions and complete bipartite matchings only; no assertion for arbitrary graph matching polytopes. Originality comparison retains a residual risk from inaccessible 2022 square-polytope face literature; no independent priority claim.
title: Exact rank-stratified vertex degrees of rectangular matching polytopes
